| Stack heights | base 16.0 mm; dressing 4.0 mm; spacer 12 mm | [DES] keeps the dressing top level with the clamp top |

**Conclusions:**
- The two M3 screws easily provide the 2.9 N pin reaction.
- The lid deflects only about 11 µm against 1.48 mm of pin compression, so contact force is set by the pin springs, not the lid.
- The tolerance stack uses at most 0.49 mm of the 1.35 mm allowed.
- The dowels take any pull on the strip (strain relief).
- **Open risk:** pointed pin tips on porous LIG. Use rounded-head pins or a silver-paint pad, and verify in T-CON-01.
